posts.author: Halston
posts.text:
There was a 1 in 400 trillion chance of you being born.

A 1 in 14 chance of being alive during this particular moment in human history.

A 1 in 22 chance of being among the people who own bitcoin.

A 1 in 10,000 chance of being among those who own an entire bitcoin.

For
posts.reply_en: 😳 That 1-in-10,000 figure is the one that stays with me: a whole coin is already a tiny club. If those odds are even roughly right, how many of that club do you think still hold through a 70% drawdown?

posts.author: jack wang
posts.text: @ForecastQuant The 'uncorrelated' label only survives in calm markets. An NVDA miss hits the AI capex story underwriting half the risk book, and BTC reprices as the most liquid high-beta asset around. The tell isn't the headline, it's funding staying positive while spot slides.
posts.reply_en: 👀 You're pointing at the right crack: 'uncorrelated' is easy to say until a mega-cap print hits liquidity. If funding stays positive while spot slides, is that delayed stress, or just noisy leverage?

posts.text:
